This template is used to include a section for access to an audio file in the [[Lojban by Choice]] wikibook. It is used like this:

<pre>{{SbcAudio | id=<filename without extension> | title=<title>}}</pre>

There is a specialized template ([[Template:SbcAudioLojbanPod]]) to include audio files in the LojbanPod lessons.
[[Category:Lojban by Choice/Templates|Audio]]</noinclude>
